Recursive Hell: Breaking Python Protobuf with Nested 'Any' Messages
Vulnerability ID: CVE-2026-0994 CVSS Score: 8.2 Published: 2026-01-23 A logic flaw in Google's Python Protobuf implementation allows attackers to bypass recursion limits using nested 'Any' types, leading to a Denial of Service via stack exhaustion. The Python implementation of Protocol Buffers contained a critical oversight in how it parsed 'Well-Known Types' nested inside google.protobuf.Any messages. By recursively nesting Any messages, an attacker could bypass the max_recursion_depth check entirely. This allows a relatively small JSON payload to trigger an infinite recursion loop in the parsing logic, hitting the Python interpreter's stack limit and crashing the application (DoS).
